tools.name: loan_create
tools.description: Mint a new PKP, create a Bitcoin custody vault, and register a new lending position with the given term. May take 60–90 seconds against the live protocol (LIT Action invocation). Requires human confirmation (confirmed: true).

confirmed.description: Human authorization gate — must be set to true by a HUMAN (not the model) to execute this irreversible action.

tools.name: loan_mint
tools.description: Mint (borrow) UCD against an existing lending position's BTC collateral. The origination fee is ADDED TO YOUR DEBT — you receive the full amount, you owe amount + fee. Ceiling: position_status → valuation.maxMintableUcd (directly usable as amountUcd). May take 60–90 seconds against the live protocol (LIT Action invocation). Requires human confirmation (confirmed: true).

confirmed.description: Human authorization gate — must be set to true by a HUMAN (not the model) to execute this irreversible action.

tools.name: loan_pay
tools.description: Repay (partial or full) a position's UCD debt. Moves UCD out of your wallet (irreversible). To pay off EVERYTHING exactly — including dust smaller than the 6-decimal input allows — pass repayAll: true instead of amountUcd (fleet finding: debt can carry more precision than amountUcd accepts). May take 60–90 seconds against the live protocol (LIT Action invocation). Requires human confirmation (confirmed: true).

amountUcd.description: Amount of UCD to repay (max 6 decimals; omit when repayAll)

repayAll.description: true = repay the position's EXACT outstanding debt (wei-precise)

confirmed.description: Human authorization gate — must be set to true by a HUMAN (not the model) to execute this irreversible action.

tools.name: loan_extend
tools.description: ADDS selectedTerm onto the position's CURRENT expiry (12 months = exactly 365 days; any other term = N × 30-day months) — never replaces or shortens it. Only available in the FINAL 30 DAYS of the current term, and refused if the remaining runway would exceed 2× the new term. (Per-network caveat: some DEPLOYED contracts predate this window/runway rule — a live extend may execute from now rather than refuse; the MCP reports the on-chain result truthfully.) Fee: ADDED TO YOUR DEBT (your wallet is not charged), at most the term's extension fee rate × your current debt (see protocol_terms; a flat rate per renewal, not per month), reduced by origination fees already paid this term. Only an ACTIVE position can be renewed. Irreversible on-chain write. May take 60–90 seconds against the live protocol (LIT Action invocation). Requires human confirmation (confirmed: true).

selectedTerm.description: Months to ADD to the current expiry (must be an offered term: see protocol_terms)

confirmed.description: Human authorization gate — must be set to true by a HUMAN (not the model) to execute this irreversible action.

tools.name: loan_withdraw
tools.description: Withdraw BTC from a position's custody vault to an external BTC address. BTC sends are UNRECOVERABLE — verify the destination address carefully. Result identifiers: txid (and txRef.id) is the Bitcoin transaction of the withdrawal reservation; authorization.digest is the borrower wallet's signature over the approval — they are different things. May take 60–90 seconds against the live protocol (LIT Action invocation). Requires human confirmation (confirmed: true).

btcAddress.description: Destination BTC address (must match the configured BTC network)

amountSats.description: GROSS amount in satoshis committed from the vault (1 BTC = 100,000,000 sats). The destination receives amountSats − networkFeeSats; the vault's available drops by amountSats. amountSats may be up to the whole available balance (a full sweep leaves 0 sats; anything above available reverts TargetExceedsInputValue). position_status.maxWithdrawableSats is a ready-to-use value that already leaves the default fee aside.

networkFeeSats.description: BTC network fee in sats (declared default 1000); deducted FROM amountSats, not added on top

confirmed.description: Human authorization gate — must be set to true by a HUMAN (not the model) to execute this irreversible action.

tools.name: loan_withdraw_retry
tools.description: Finish a withdrawal that authorized but never broadcast. loan_withdraw has two steps: the first commits the reservation on-chain, the second signs a time-stamped hash whose window is under a minute — often nearer twenty seconds. If that second signature is not given in time the withdrawal fails with the reservation ALREADY committed and the coins still in the vault, and it does not clear itself: loan_recover_stale_spend needs the coins to have MOVED, which is exactly what did not happen. This re-runs the second step alone with a fresh stamp. Destination and amount come from the on-chain record, not from you — the only figure you supply is the network fee, which is taken OUT of the already-authorized amount and cannot increase what leaves the vault. Use position_pending_withdrawals to see what is outstanding first. Sends real BTC. May take 60–90 seconds against the live protocol (LIT Action invocation). Requires human confirmation (confirmed: true).

networkFeeSats.description: BTC network fee in sats (declared default 1000); taken FROM the authorized amount, not added on top

confirmed.description: Human authorization gate — must be set to true by a HUMAN (not the model) to execute this irreversible action.

tools.name: loan_allowlist_destination
tools.description: Add a BTC address to the borrower's withdrawal allowlist (BitcoinWithdrawalAddressRegistry). The protocol refuses withdrawBTC to any destination not on the borrower's own allowlist. For a SAFE borrower this is itself a Safe transaction — owner signatures are collected, and owners can sign at their leisure (no expiry on this ceremony). The destination becomes usable after the registry's address delay, read LIVE from the contract at execution — the result's usableAtSec is the chain-derived moment it becomes usable (never assume a fixed delay). Requires human confirmation (confirmed: true).

btcAddress.description: Destination BTC address to allowlist (must match the configured BTC network)

confirmed.description: Human authorization gate — must be set to true by a HUMAN (not the model) to execute this irreversible action.

tools.name: loan_delegation_setup
tools.description: NOT AVAILABLE on the real protocol in this build — the real adapter answers UPSTREAM_UNAVAILABLE ('not wired in this delivery'). It runs on the practice (mock) adapter only. Say so before a user plans around it. The ONE-TIME Safe delegation batch (signer mode 'safe-module'): your owners sign a single durable Safe transaction — at their leisure, no time window — that enables the Safe's AgentModule, binds the agent key, registers it in the delegation registry, and pre-approves the given BTC withdrawal destinations. After it, day-to-day operations (create/mint/pay/extend) run agent-solo; withdrawals always still need the owners' short signing burst, and only to destinations approved here (or later via loan_allowlist_destination — also owners-only). A revoked agent address burns FOREVER (AR-1) — rotation means a fresh key. Requires human confirmation (confirmed: true).

btcAddresses.description: BTC withdrawal destinations to pre-approve in the same ceremony (avoids a second owner gathering before the first withdrawal)

confirmed.description: Human authorization gate — must be set to true by a HUMAN (not the model) to execute this irreversible action.

tools.name: loan_delegation_grant
tools.description: NOT AVAILABLE on the real protocol in this build — the real adapter answers UPSTREAM_UNAVAILABLE ('not wired in this delivery'). It runs on the practice (mock) adapter only. Say so before a user plans around it. Set what the delegated agent may do on ONE position — RENEW (extend), REPAY (pay down), MINT (borrow, only while the post-mint collateral ratio stays at or above mintFloorBps — required for MINT, it is the owners' risk bound). Grants are user-only expansion: for a Safe this is a QUORUM signature (durable Safe transaction, owners sign at leisure) — the agent can never widen its own powers. Omitting a scope leaves it un-granted; a grant with no scopes clears the position's grant. Requires human confirmation (confirmed: true).

renew.description: Allow the agent to extend/renew this position

repay.description: Allow the agent to pay down this position's debt

mintFloorBps.description: Allow MINT while post-mint CR ≥ this floor (bps, e.g. 15000 = 150%) — required for the MINT scope

confirmed.description: Human authorization gate — must be set to true by a HUMAN (not the model) to execute this irreversible action.

tools.name: loan_recover_stale_spend
tools.description: NOT AVAILABLE on the real protocol in this build — the real adapter answers UPSTREAM_UNAVAILABLE ('not wired in this delivery'); it runs on the practice (mock) adapter only. For a withdrawal that authorized but never broadcast, loan_withdraw_retry is the working path. Clear a stale authorized BTC spend on BTCSpendAuthorizer using a LIT-attested StaleSpendRecovery attestation. The original UTXO must already be consumed on Bitcoin with ≥6 confirmations. `invalidatorTxid` is either the borrower's authorized broadcast (after confirmations) or a PKP self-spend that invalidated the reservation. Permissionless on-chain.

invalidatorTxid.description: Txid of the BTC transaction that consumed the original UTXO (≥6 confirmations)

tools.name: position_status
tools.description: Return detailed status for a single position: chain facts (debt, term, expiry, state), live collateral (confirmed sats + per-transaction pending deposits, plus maxWithdrawableSats — directly usable as a withdrawal amountSats), and a basis-carrying valuation (maxMintableUcd is directly usable as amountUcd). If a withdrawal reservation was already spent on Bitcoin but availableSats still shows it deducted, run loan_recover_stale_spend to release the redundant hold. Any `reading` notes in the result are authoritative interpretation instructions for that exact payload — follow them. Field guide: state = lifecycle state. On position_status it is read from the CHAIN (authoritative); on position_list rows it is an INDEXER snapshot that can lag the chain. PENDING_DEPOSIT/PENDING_MINT mean 'not yet minted' — activation happens on the FIRST mint, never on deposit confirmation alone; availableSats = CONFIRMED collateral in satoshis, minus authorized (reserved) spends — deposits count only once their confirmations reach minConfirmations. null ONLY alongside a SOURCE_DEGRADED warning, never a fabricated zero; minConfirmations = the protocol's REQUIRED confirmation threshold — a PARAMETER, never a live count; compare each pendingDeposits[].confirmations against it; pendingDeposits = the LIVE per-transaction list of unconfirmed deposits — each entry carries its own confirmations count. EMPTY ARRAY = nothing unconfirmed in flight (not an error). null ONLY with a SOURCE_DEGRADED warning; maxWithdrawableSats = directly usable as loan_withdraw amountSats: availableSats minus the default network fee, tightened by the liquidation floor while debt is outstanding; maxMintableUcd = the SAME ceiling as a directly-usable loan_mint amountUcd value; debtUcdWei = current UCD debt in wei (18 decimals); 0 means debt-free, NOT closed.

tools.name: position_list
tools.description: List positions with optional filters. `borrower` and `state` COMBINE (logical AND); with no filter, returns active positions. Rows are the INDEXER's view — `state` here is an indexer snapshot that can lag the chain; position_status reads the chain and is authoritative for one position. Field guide: state = lifecycle state. On position_status it is read from the CHAIN (authoritative); on position_list rows it is an INDEXER snapshot that can lag the chain. PENDING_DEPOSIT/PENDING_MINT mean 'not yet minted' — activation happens on the FIRST mint, never on deposit confirmation alone; debtUcdWei = current UCD debt in wei (18 decimals); 0 means debt-free, NOT closed; indexedHealth = indexer-computed health snapshot; null when the indexer lags — the chain facts still stand.

state.description: Filter by state (PENDING_DEPOSIT, PENDING_MINT, ACTIVE, EXPIRED, LIQUIDATABLE, LIQUIDATED, REPAID, CLOSED)

tools.name: position_events
tools.description: Return mint, payment, withdrawal, renewal, and liquidation events for a position (indexer view). NOT IMPLEMENTED on the real protocol adapter in this build — it answers NOT_IMPLEMENTED there (a PERMANENT gap, not a transient outage: do not retry). Available on the practice (mock) adapter.

tools.name: position_pending_withdrawals
tools.description: Query the spend authorizer for BTC withdrawal reservations on a position. Each entry has txid/vout, satoshis, and target address (txid/vout feed recovery).

tools.name: btc_balance
tools.description: Query the confirmed BTC balance for an address (source-tagged).

tools.name: btc_price
tools.description: Return the current BTC price (USD, 8 decimals) from the price oracle.

tools.name: protocol_status
tools.description: Return protocol status: pause flag, mint LTV limit (ltvBps), liquidation threshold (liquidationThresholdBps — a COLLATERAL RATIO in bps, i.e. collateralValue/debt, so 11000 = 110%; note this is the inverse basis of ltvBps which is debt/collateral), deposit confirmation threshold, BTC network.

tools.name: protocol_terms
tools.description: Return all configured loan terms (in months) with their fees. Term length: 12 months = exactly 365 days; any other term = N × 30-day months. originationFeeBps: % of a mint, ADDED to debt. extensionFeeRateBps: the renewal fee CEILING as % of outstanding debt PER RENEWAL (a flat rate, NOT per month); the charged fee is ADDED TO DEBT and reduced by origination fees already paid this term.

tools.name: psm_quote
tools.description: Quote the PSM exchange (read-only, live on-chain views — never an indexer). direction 'to-ucd' = pay the stablecoin, receive UCD; the ENTRY fee is charged IN UCD on the gross converted amount. direction 'from-ucd' = pay UCD, receive the stablecoin back from the PSM's reserves; the EXIT fee is charged IN that stablecoin and deducted from what you receive. amount is in the INPUT token's user units (to-ucd: the stablecoin; from-ucd: UCD). The result names both amounts, the fee WITH its token, and (from-ucd) the live reserves. Executing an exchange on-chain requires a minimum-out floor — a zero floor is refused — so a drifted quote refuses at execution instead of delivering less. Limits and kill-switches: protocol://psm.

stablecoin.description: The stablecoin to exchange, by SYMBOL (e.g. 'USDC', 'USDT') or by 0x address. REQUIRED and deliberately has NO DEFAULT: the PSM can support several coins, and choosing one for the user would move their money through a token they did not name. Read protocol://psm for the coins this deployment supports. The choice is verified against the PSM contract on-chain before anything signs.

direction.description: 'to-ucd' = pay the stablecoin, get UCD (contract swap); 'from-ucd' = pay UCD, get the stablecoin back (contract redeem)

amount.description: Amount of the INPUT token in user units (to-ucd: the stablecoin; from-ucd: UCD). Max 6 decimals.

tools.name: psm_swap
tools.description: Execute a PSM exchange (irreversible, fund-moving). direction 'to-ucd' = pay the stablecoin, receive UCD; 'from-ucd' = pay UCD (burned), receive the stablecoin from the PSM's reserves. Runs as explicit on-chain ceremonies, each signed by the session signer and all reported in the result: (1) the approvals the input token NEEDS, planned against its standing allowance — none when the allowance already covers the amount; one EXACT-AMOUNT approval when it is 0; a reset to 0 followed by the exact approval when a partial allowance stands. to-ucd approves the stablecoin to the PSM contract (the PSM pulls the coin it converts); from-ucd approves UCD to the UCDController (the PSM burns UCD through the controller — a DIFFERENT spender, by design). Never an unlimited approval. (2) the swap/redeem itself, carrying a mandatory minimum-out floor set to the live quote minus a 100 bps tolerance — a zero floor is refused by the contract, and if the quote drifts beyond the floor the exchange REFUSES rather than delivering less. Output always goes to the signer's own address (the contract pays msg.sender only). Fees: to-ucd charges the entry fee IN UCD on the gross converted amount; from-ucd charges the exit fee IN the stablecoin, deducted from what you receive. amount is in the INPUT token's user units (to-ucd: the stablecoin; from-ucd: UCD). Requires human confirmation (confirmed: true).

stablecoin.description: The stablecoin to exchange, by SYMBOL (e.g. 'USDC', 'USDT') or by 0x address. REQUIRED and deliberately has NO DEFAULT: the PSM can support several coins, and choosing one for the user would move their money through a token they did not name. Read protocol://psm for the coins this deployment supports. The choice is verified against the PSM contract on-chain before anything signs.

direction.description: 'to-ucd' = pay the stablecoin, get UCD (contract swap); 'from-ucd' = pay UCD, get the stablecoin back (contract redeem)

amount.description: Amount of the INPUT token in user units (to-ucd: the stablecoin; from-ucd: UCD). Max 6 decimals.

tools.name: signer_setup
tools.description: Pick or inspect the authorization mode by conversation — no config files. Modes: 'external' = you approve each operation in YOUR OWN wallet (browser popup, or mobile via WalletConnect); 'keystore' = a local keystore signs automatically after each confirmation; 'safe' = operate AS a Safe smart-account (provide safeAddress; owners and threshold are discovered, never typed; operations are authorized by owner signatures); 'safe-module' = a Safe WITH DELEGATION: owners approve ONCE (loan_delegation_setup), then the keystore key acts as the Safe's agent for day-to-day operations — withdrawals and new destinations always remain owner-quorum acts; 'mock-simulated' = the test-world simulated ceremony. Actions: 'status' (what is active, what is ready, what is missing — start here), 'use' (switch mode), 'reset-borrower' (identity swap ONLY — unbinds the discovered identity but keeps the wallet connection and login alive; it is NOT a disconnect), 'unlock-keystore' (opens the secure local page for the password — NEVER paste passwords into chat), 'connect' (external mode, real protocol: run the one-time login signature in your wallet so authenticated reads work — reads never open wallet popups on their own), 'disconnect' (log out of the external wallet: the FULL flush — ends approval-page sessions and WalletConnect, discards and revokes the login token, unbinds the identity; reconnecting requires opening the page and signing again). Synonyms users may say: 'use my own wallet / MetaMask / my phone' → external; 'sign automatically / no popups' → keystore; 'use our Safe / multisig / company wallet' → safe; 'disconnect / log out / sign out / forget my wallet / remove my wallet' → disconnect.

mode.description: For 'use': external | keystore | safe | safe-module | mock-simulated

safeAddress.description: For 'use safe'/'use safe-module': the Safe's 0x address (the borrowing identity)

tools.name: network_switch
tools.description: Which world this server is on — and switching it by conversation (real adapter). 'status' states the active network and whether money is real. 'switch' moves this session between sepolia (practice funds) and mainnet (REAL MONEY) after an explicit human confirmation; positions, vaults, and signer bindings are per-network and do not carry across. Fund-moving operations work on BOTH networks — loan operations and PSM swaps alike (on mainnet they move REAL money). The switch lasts for this server session only; the configured default returns on restart. After a switch, re-read boundary://info and STATE the new environment to the user.

action.description: status = current world; switch = change network (needs confirmed:true)

confirmed.description: HUMAN approval of this exact switch — never auto-set

instructions: Diamond Hands MCP — Bitcoin-collateralized borrowing. Before promising ANY flow, read the boundary://info resource and honor its `capabilities` block: it states which network this server is on, whether money is real (practiceWorld), whether writes are enabled (and the true reason when they are not), and which signer modes this build actually offers — never describe a flow outside it. State the network and whether funds are real when the user first acts. Authorization is chosen by conversation via the signer_setup tool (when listed); writes always require confirmed:true after showing the human-readable card. For walkthroughs consult the guide tool / guide:// resources instead of inventing steps; when a tool refuses, relay its stated reason and remedy — do not improvise alternatives. When a network_switch tool is listed, the network can change mid-session — after ANY switch, re-read boundary://info and state the new network and money reality to the user before doing anything else. When the user asks to disconnect / log out / sign out / forget or remove their wallet, call signer_setup action 'disconnect' (the full flush) — never treat 'reset-borrower' as a disconnect; it only swaps identity. READING DATA: a payload's fields and notes are authoritative — state what they say, never speculate past them, and when the data does not carry something, say 'the data does not carry X'. Field meanings live in guide topic 'reading-data'; `reading` notes inside a result are interpretation instructions for that exact payload — follow them over any prior assumption.
